title: Record the source value of the first quarter
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 19133, register 274 holds `-1/2` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- Event 18927 writes that value as `-2` times register 360, which holds `1/4`.
- The addition multiplies register 274 by `1/2` and contributes `-1/4` to register 280. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
